findings.reasoning: In Radix UI / shadcn DialogContent implementations, DialogPrimitive.Close is rendered as an absolute-positioned element after {children}. Under CSS stacking context and normal painting order rules, elements later in DOM order with auto z-index paint on top of preceding sibling content. Neither the enclosing div nor DialogTitle declares a positioned stacking context or higher z-index that would elevate it above the close button. Consequently, even if activity.place is exceptionally long and reaches the top-right corner, it renders beneath the close button and cannot occlude or intercept pointer events targeting the close button.
